about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Sunday within the Octave of the Nativity of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Through the working of this mystery, O Lord, may our vices be cleansed and our rightful desires fulfilled. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
